verdict.rationale: Salv publishes an API reference at docs.salv.com/api built from a downloadable OpenAPI definition (public.yaml) that it explicitly offers for Postman import. The spec includes an environment selector with a 'demo' sandbox, so requests can be run against a sandbox rather than production. However, nothing shows that the reference itself is interactive or ships runnable in-page examples; running calls appears to require importing the spec into Postman. Missing for 10: an in-browser try-it console, documented runnable code examples, and hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity.
